newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: IVORIAN COCOA ARRIVALS AT 1.085 MLN T BY JULY 21.
newsitem.headline: IVORIAN COCOA ARRIVALS AT 1.085 MLN T BY JULY 21.

text.p: Arrivals of Ivory Coast's 1996/97 season cocoa crop (October-September) at ports totalled about 1.085 million tonnes by July 21, port sources said on Tuesday.

Exporters said arrivals had picked up slightly in mid-July after a slow start to the mid-crop season (May-September) when total weekly arrivals for both ports had slipped to around 5,000 tonnes a week.
Arrivals by July 13 stood at 1.06-1.07 million tonnes, the sources said.
Exporters say some 1996/97 crop could be stored by farmers until October in the hope of a higher state-set reference farmgate price -- currently 495 CFA a kg.
